title.zh: 美股期指下跌，Alphabet 财报引发AI交易担忧
title.en: US Stock Index Futures Drop After Alphabet Earnings Shake AI Trade

summary.en: US equity futures pared losses as Alphabet's earnings report stirs AI sector jitters. Fed held rates steady at 3.75%-4.00%, but strong GDP and rising inflation data keep yields near 5%. DXY strengthened while oil prices surged on geopolitical tensions. Mixed signals ahead for the open with growth names under pressure.
summary.zh: Alphabet 财报引发市场对 AI 板块的担忧，美股期货跌幅收窄。美联储维持利率在 3.75% 至 4.00% 不变，但强劲的 GDP 数据和通胀升温使美债收益率维持在 5% 附近。美元指数走强，地缘局势紧张推升油价。开盘前信号不一，成长股承压。

title.zh: 美联储将维持利率，投资者在通胀担忧中等待鹰派转向
title.en: Fed to hold rates as investors await hawkish pivot amid inflation concerns

summary.en: Markets face a pivotal day ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision with expectations for a hawkish hold. Tech earnings from Alphabet and Microsoft will provide key AI debt tests, while European bank earnings show strength. SK Hynix's strong results may lift semiconductors. Inflation concerns persist with AI-driven demand pushing prices higher.
summary.zh: 市场迎来美联储利率决议前的关键交易日。投资者预期美联储将维持利率不变，并释放偏鹰信号。Alphabet 和微软的财报将帮助市场评估 AI 投资相关的债务压力，欧洲银行表现强劲。SK Hynix 的强劲业绩或提振半导体板块。通胀担忧持续存在，AI 驱动的需求推高物价。

title.zh: 博通和英伟德因 Anthropic 和 Meta AI 交易而上涨
title.en: Broadcom and Nvidia Rise on Anthropic and Meta AI Deals

summary.en: US markets eye a busy earnings week with Big Tech names and AI chip makers leading premarket gains. Middle East diplomacy offers relief to oil prices while investors await the Fed's rate decision.
summary.zh: 美股迎来财报密集的一周，大科技公司和 AI 芯片股领涨盘前。中东外交进展减轻了油价的上行压力，投资者等待美联储利率决策。

title.zh: 美联储官员暗示对第四季度进一步降息持谨慎态度
title.en: Fed Officials Signal Cautious Approach to Additional Rate Cuts in Q4

summary.en: US markets closed mixed as investors weighed ongoing rate cut expectations against lingering recession fears. Tech stocks showed resilience while energy sector faced headwinds from elevated oil prices.
summary.zh: 美股收市表现分化，投资者在持续降息预期与衰退担忧间权衡。科技股表现稳健，而能源板块受到高油价影响承压。

title.zh: 中东紧张局势推升油价，地缘政治风险溢价扩大
title.en: Middle East Tensions Drive Oil Rally as Geopolitical Risk Premium Expands

summary.en: U.S. equities face headwinds as Middle East tensions lift oil prices and AI-related jitters pressure tech stocks ahead of key earnings. Nasdaq futures fall over 1% while investors weigh Tesla and Meta results. Broader market sentiment is risk-off amid geopolitical uncertainty and inflation concerns.
summary.zh: 美股面临阻力，中东紧张局势推高油价，AI 担忧打压科技股。纳斯达克期货跌超 1%，投资者关注特斯拉和META财报。地缘政治不确定性和通胀担忧导致市场情绪避险。

title.zh: SpaceX 财报超预期，盘前股价大涨 9%
title.en: SpaceX earnings beat expectations, stock surges 9% in premarket

summary.en: SpaceX's stellar earnings report (+9%) and Super Micro Computer surge (+12.7%) drive AI sector rally, with Nasdaq futures climbing ahead of opening bell. Chipmakers NVIDIA, AMD, and Micron jump 3% on upbeat AI sentiment despite Meta's $25B penalty headline.
summary.zh: SpaceX 强劲财报（+9%）和超微电脑大涨（+12.7%）带动 AI 板块反弹，盘前纳斯达克期货上涨。芯片股 NVIDIA、AMD 和 Micron 受积极 AI 情绪推动涨 3%，尽管 Meta 面临 250 亿美元罚款消息影响。

title.zh: CoreWeave 信用压力加剧，AI 板块重新定价持续
title.en: CoreWeave Credit Stress Intensifies, AI Sector Repricing Continues

summary.en: US markets show mixed sentiment as investors digest hot inflation data from earlier in the week. AI sector faces pressure from CoreWeave credit stress concerns while traditional sectors like energy and precious metals benefit from rate-sensitive positioning. Futures indicate cautious optimism with S&P 500 ETFs rising, Nasdaq edging higher on Tesla gains, but broader tech weighing on sentiment.
summary.zh: 美股市场呈现混合情绪，投资者正在消化本周早些时候公布的通胀数据。AI 行业因 CoreWeave 信用压力而承压，而能源和贵金属等传统板块受益于利率敏感型配置。期货显示谨慎乐观：SPY 上涨，纳指因特斯拉股价上涨微涨，但科技板块整体拖累情绪。

title.zh: 上午 8:30 ET 的 CPI 通胀报告仍是今天的主要焦点
title.en: CPI Inflation Report at 8:30 AM ET Remains Day's Primary Focus

summary.en: Premarket sentiment cautious as investors await key CPI inflation data at 8:30 AM ET. Oil prices elevated near $106 from geopolitical supply concerns, while tech sector shows mixed signals ahead of earnings season. Market positioning defensive with growth stocks waiting for inflation clarity before directional moves.
summary.zh: 盘前情绪谨慎，投资者等待上午 8:30 ET 的关键 CPI 通胀数据。受地缘政治供应担忧影响，油价维持在近 106 美元的高位，而科技板块在财报季前走势分化。市场配置偏向防御，成长股投资者等待通胀形势进一步明朗。

title.zh: 美股期货在 CPI 数据前上涨；BlackRock 因积极催化剂而跳涨
title.en: US Stock Futures Rise Ahead of CPI Data; BlackRock Jumps on Positive Catalyst

summary.en: Stock futures rose in premarket as investors awaited the key CPI inflation report at 8:30 AM ET. Oil prices climbed near $106 following Aramco strike supply concerns, while BlackRock shares jumped on positive catalysts. Mixed sentiment with growth stocks holding steady ahead of rate-sensitive positioning.
summary.zh: 盘前股市期货上涨，投资者等待上午 8:30 ET 的关键 CPI 通胀报告。受沙特阿美罢工供应担忧影响，油价升至近 106 美元，BlackRock 股份因积极催化剂而上涨。成长股持稳，整体情绪混合。

title.zh: 美股期货因地缘政治不确定性和油价波动而表现分化
title.en: US Stock Futures Mixed on Geopolitical Uncertainty and Oil Price Fluctuations

summary.en: U.S. stock futures were mixed ahead of Monday's open as investors assessed geopolitical developments, with oil prices fluctuating amid ceasefire claims and Iran tensions. The market is positioning for an earnings-heavy week led by large banks, while AI chip stocks remain under pressure from OpenAI revenue concerns but show signs of recovery.
summary.zh: 美股期货在周一开盘前表现分化，投资者正在评估地缘政治发展，油价在停火声明与伊朗紧张局势间波动。市场正布局以大型银行为主的业绩周，而受 OpenAI 收入担忧打压的 AI 芯片股显示复苏迹象。

title.zh: 半导体股票受 AI 营收担忧压制，尽管大盘整体反弹
title.en: Semiconductor stocks pressured on AI revenue concerns despite broader market rally

summary.en: US stock futures rose pre-market as AI-related stocks recovered despite semiconductor concerns, while oil prices slipped from recent geopolitical-driven highs. The dollar showed mixed strength and Treasury yields declined amid Middle East tensions affecting energy markets.
summary.zh: 美股期货盘前上涨，AI 相关股票在半导体担忧中企稳，油价从地缘政治推高的水平回落。美元走势分化，美债收益率因中东局势影响能源市场而下降。

title.zh: 大型科技公司的混合第三季度指引抑制了纳斯达克情绪
title.en: Mixed Q3 earnings guidance from mega-cap tech firms weighing on Nasdaq sentiment

summary.en: US markets remain neutral amid mixed earnings signals ahead of key FOMC meeting later this month. Investors wait for Q3 guidance from mega-cap tech names while monitoring inflation data releases that could shift Fed expectations.
summary.zh: 美国股市在重要 FOMC 会议本月稍后举行之际保持中立态度。投资者等待大型科技公司的第三季度指引，同时监测可能改变美联储预期的通胀数据发布。

title.zh: 美联储理事 Warsh 暗示将在下次 FOMC 会议上讨论可能的利率降息
title.en: Fed Governor Warsh Signals Potential Rate Cut Discussions at Next FOMC Meeting

summary.en: Pre-market focus remains on Fed speaker Warsh's upcoming comments, oil prices hovering near geopolitical tightropes, and big tech earnings season expectations. Growth stocks show cautious optimism as investors weigh rate cut timing against inflation stickiness.
summary.zh: 盘前焦点集中在美联储官员 Warsh 的即将发表言论、油价在地缘政治边缘徘徊，以及大科技股盈利预期。成长股表现谨慎乐观，投资者在降息时点与通胀粘性之间权衡。

title.zh: 油价跌破 100 美元，提振股市期指
title.en: Oil Falls Below $100, Boosting Stock Futures

summary.en: US stock futures edge higher premarket as oil prices dip below $100 and Treasury yields ease, with tech-driven gains leading the way. Markets await key earnings announcements while geopolitical developments continue to influence cross-asset flows.
summary.zh: 美股期指盘前小幅走强，油价跌破 100 美元、美债收益率回落支撑市场情绪。科技股领涨大盘，投资者正密切关注即将公布的财报以及地缘政治对跨资产流动的影响。

title.zh: 科技股休整期叠加高国债收益率，美股期货走低
title.en: Wall Street futures slip as tech stocks take a breather amid elevated Treasury yields

summary.en: Wall Street futures slip amid stubbornly high Treasury yields, with investors weighing elevated rates against ongoing AI sector momentum. Key market data shows Dow Jones futures -0.14%, Nasdaq 100 futures -0.24% while oil prices dip to ~$90-105 on G7 reserve releases. DXY strengthens as Fed rate-cut bets unwind.
summary.zh: 美股期货在国债收益率保持坚挺的背景下小幅走弱，投资者在高利率与持续 AI 板块动量之间权衡。关键市场数据显示道琼斯期货下跌 0.14%，纳斯达克 100 期货下跌 0.24%，油价因 G7 释放战略储备而跌至约 90-105 美元区间。美元指数在美联储降息预期退潮后走强。

title.zh: 科技财报季加速，AI 芯片龙头表现超出预期
title.en: Tech Earnings Season Accelerates with AI Chip Leaders Delivering Above Expectations

summary.en: Friday pre-market shows mixed sentiment as investors weigh year-end positioning and upcoming earnings announcements. Geopolitical developments in the Middle East continue to support oil prices while Fed policy expectations remain data-dependent.
summary.zh: 周五盘前情绪分化，投资者权衡年末配置和即将发布的财报。中东地缘政治发展继续支撑油价，美联储政策预期仍取决于数据。

title.zh: 美联储官员暗示在通胀粘性担忧下对降息保持耐心
title.en: Fed Officials Signal Patience on Rate Cuts Amid Sticky Inflation Concerns

summary.en: Pre-market outlook remains cautious ahead of key macro data releases including CPI expectations and Fed policy discussions. Sector divergence expected with AI/semiconductors resilient while energy trades on geopolitical developments.
summary.zh: 盘前谨慎观望，等待关键宏观数据发布包括通胀预期和美联储政策讨论。板块分化，AI 半导体表现稳健而能源受地缘政治影响交易活跃。

title.zh: 软 PCE 通胀数据缓解美联储加息担忧；市场隔夜反弹
title.en: Soft PCE Inflation Data Eases Fed Rate Hike Fears; Markets Rally Overnight

summary.en: Soft inflation data and strong PCE/ADP reports eased rate-hike fears, pushing Wall Street futures higher overnight. Focus remains on AI chip supply chains (Micron earnings catalyst) and broader tech sector positioning ahead of Fed speakers.
summary.zh: 软通胀数据和强劲的 PCE/ADP 报告缓解了加息担忧，推动美股期货隔夜走高。焦点集中在 AI 芯片供应链（美光业绩催化剂）和大盘科技板块在美联储发言前的大盘配置。
